title: benchmark_source
description: Identifies the provenance of a benchmark case, including its source type and all upstream benchmarks involved.

case_id.description: Unique case identifier within this project.

case_source.description: How the case was created: official (from upstream benchmark), benchmark-derived (adapted from public benchmark), multi-benchmark-derived (combines multiple benchmark sources), videoweaver_official_reserved (reserved for future VideoWeaver dataset release, currently disabled).

official_benchmark_case.description: True if this case is an unmodified official case from an upstream benchmark. False for derived/adapted cases.

task_content_source.description: The benchmark that provides the task content/prompt.

agentic_execution_basis.description: The benchmark that provides the agentic execution pattern.
